subject: Post-demo: hosted pilot prefetch strategy & onramp checkpoints

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-demo: hosted pilot prefetch strategy & onramp checkpoints

Hi Kim — great to meet today, thanks for taking the demo. Quick recap and next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

What we covered
- Demo: hosted inference flow, prefix/KV prefetch and warm-start options, streaming output.
- Key decision area: you indicated preference to start on Hosted API for speed, with a possible migration to Private VPC later for PII-sensitive flows.
- Ops asks: sandbox endpoints, rate limits per endpoint, and a small traffic sample to size initial concurrency.

What I need from you to get a sandbox spun up
1) A short traffic sample (CSV is fine) showing expected request patterns: avg requests/min, typical request size (tokens), and peak bursts.
2) Confirmation of which routes you want isolated initially (NLP-parse, product-ranker, recommendations). If you want a single aggregated endpoint, tell me which workload is priority.
3) Any hard security constraints (e.g., mandatory VPC, IP allowlist only) that would block starting on Hosted.

Proposed Redwood next steps
- I'll attach a short Quickstart Playbook with endpoint mapping, prefetch/prefix guidance, and recommended rate buckets.
- If you send the traffic sample, we'll propose endpoint rate ceilings and a canary schedule within 48 hours.
- We'll provision a sandbox with 2 endpoints (staging + canary) and a temporary API key for your infra team to exercise.

Tentative times for an ops call to finalize mapping: Tue 3/30 10:00-10:30am PT or Wed 3/31 8:30-9:00am PT — which works?

Attachments: redwood_quickstart-playbook.pdf (ops checklist + endpoint mapping)

Thanks — I’ll wait for the small traffic extract and any blockers.

— Mateo

On Mon, 29 Mar 2027 at 17:04, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Kim — great to meet today, thanks for taking the demo. Quick recap and next steps so we don't lose momentum:
> 
> What I need from you to get a sandbox spun up

Answers:
- Traffic sample: attached (catalyst_traffic-sample.csv). It covers a 48-hour slice of production-like calls to our current NLU service. Typical request size ~120 tokens, avg 22 req/min, short bursts up to 420 req/min for 90s.
- Initial routes: prioritize product-ranker and chat-assist; we'll keep the parsing/ingestion as lower priority for the first pilot.
- Security: Hosted works for this pilot; we do need IP allowlist and SOC2 evidence (we have a security checklist that your team can fill). Private VPC is on the roadmap but not required for phase 1.

We'd like the sandbox by EOD Wed if possible — infra can join the ops call.

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:18:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted pilot prefetch strategy & onramp checkpoints

Thanks Kim — traffic sample received and looks useful. Quick technical plan based on the numbers: 

1) Endpoint mapping (proposed)
- /v1/product-ranker -> dedicated endpoint (priority)
- /v1/chat-assist -> streaming-enabled endpoint with low-latency config
- /v1/parse -> shared baseline endpoint (phase 2)

2) Rate buckets (initial)
- Baseline per-endpoint: 30 reqs/min sustained
- Burst allowance: 6x baseline for 90s (to match the 420 rps-ish bursts you reported)
- Concurrency target (in sandbox): 40 concurrent tokens for ranker; we’ll iterate after measuring tail latency.

3) Prefetch / warm-start strategy
- We'll recommend prefix caching for product titles and a small KV cache for session state; this reduces tokenized prefix work for repeat queries.
- For chat-assist, we'll enable short-lived KV cache per session (30s TTL) to keep latency under 120ms for most requests.

4) Compliance / ops
- We can provide SOC2 snapshot and IP allowlist config. Monica will send the checklist and a short runbook with sandbox credentials.

Next actions
- I'll produce a brief Ops Playbook (attached) with endpoint URLs, initial rate ceilings, and test vectors — will send within 2 hours.
- Monica: can you provision the sandbox endpoints and drop a temp API key in this thread?
- Kim/Infra: confirm whether you want the canary traffic split 5% -> canary, 95% -> staging.

On availability: Wed 3/31 08:30 PT works for me.

— Mateo
